t: DEWALT XP one-piece 20oz rip claw hammer features a gravity-balanced design, ensuring optimal weight distribution and a controlled swing for reduced fatigue during prolonged use. The heat-treated steel head offers long-lasting durability, whilst a comfortable bi-material grip offers enhanced control. Also features a 36mm smooth, oval-shaped strike face to assist with toe-nailing, and a multi-use side nail puller for additional functionality. A magnetic nail starter holds fasteners securely for initial striking. Ideal for construction workers, carpenters, and DIY enthusiasts undertaking framing or dismantling work.
